Author: jFray
Name: EchoMix
Description: An interactive DJ deck with live mixing tools, custom playlists, and a synced listener mode with an audio visualizer.
Punchline: Spin tracks and let the party sync in.
Changelog: Fixed Spotify Mode's audio gradually degrading during long broadcasts (sometimes clearing up on its own after a while) - the audio filter chain could occasionally settle into a state that silently slowed down processing during quiet passages. It now stays clear of that for the whole broadcast.
